from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information identifying the specific case."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case number (e.g., (2023) 苏 1204 民初 5771 号)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the document")

class PartyInfo(BaseModel):
    """A named party involved in the legal proceedings."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Legal role, e.g., Appellant, Respondent, Applicant")

class OrderInfo(BaseModel):
    """A specific order made by the court, particularly involving money."""
    action_type: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the order (e.g., 返还，给付，驳回)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Specific monetary amount if applicable (exact number)")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays if an order involves payment")
    payee: str | None = Field(description="Who receives if an order involves payment")

class OutcomeInfo(BaseModel):
    """The core judicial conclusion or decision."""
    decision_summary: str | None = Field(description="Core decision text, e.g., 驳回上诉，维持原判，撤销原判")

class FeeInfo(BaseModel):
    """Court fee information."""
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., 一审案件受理费)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of the fee")
    bearer: str | None = Field(description="Party responsible for the fee")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extraction results for a single document."""
    case_infos: list[CaseInfo]
    party_infos: list[PartyInfo]
    order_infos: list[OrderInfo]
    outcome_infos: list[OutcomeInfo]
    fee_infos: list[FeeInfo]
